title: LED Blink
components: Arduino Uno; LED; 220 ohm resistor; wires
goal: Blink an LED on and off every second
starter_code:
void setup(){ pinMode(13, OUTPUT); }
void loop(){ digitalWrite(13, HIGH); delay(1000); }
solution_code:
void setup(){ pinMode(13, OUTPUT); }
void loop(){ digitalWrite(13, HIGH); delay(1000); digitalWrite(13, LOW); delay(1000); }

title: Buzzer + Button
components: Arduino Uno; push button; buzzer; wires
goal: Buzzer sounds only while the button is pressed
starter_code:
void setup(){ pinMode(2, INPUT_PULLUP); pinMode(8, OUTPUT); }
void loop(){ }
solution_code:
void setup(){ pinMode(2, INPUT_PULLUP); pinMode(8, OUTPUT); }
void loop(){ if(digitalRead(2)==LOW){ tone(8, 1000); } else { noTone(8); } }

title: Distance Alarm
components: Arduino Uno; HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor; buzzer; wires
goal: Beep when an object is closer than 20 cm
starter_code:
void setup(){ pinMode(9, OUTPUT); pinMode(10, INPUT); pinMode(8, OUTPUT); }
void loop(){ long d = readDistance(); }
solution_code:
void setup(){ pinMode(9, OUTPUT); pinMode(10, INPUT); pinMode(8, OUTPUT); }
void loop(){ long d = readDistance(); if(d < 20){ tone(8, 1500); } else { noTone(8); } delay(100); }
